title: Leaving Morgan for John Casimir's band
summary: Morgan's drummer and pianist, then Jones joins John Casimir's band at Claiborne and Tulane, with its trumpeters and drummers, before the band moves to the Rose Club.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And he had a drummer by the name of Albert Jow. You heard of him? Oh yeah. I knew him. Then we had all the way through, we had uh, uh, Poirier, Allison Poirier on piano.
